notes.title: Update 1.4.6
notes.content:
Update 1.4.6 is available for download!

Christmas Event
Collect 100 pieces of dropped candy to unlock festive rewards before the event finishes on January 12

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44393162/df7790b88d9b3f01fec25851edfc8f191e2d30cd.jpg

How does the event work?
Candy is dropped when you kill a player (Not AI) during non-private regular gamemodes.

What are the event rewards?
On completing the event, you will unlock 2 weapon skin bundles that are available for every weapon.

On behalf of the whole Alvo team, I would like to wish you a Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

- demolition-sean

notes.title: Update 1.4.4
notes.content:
Update 1.4.4 is available for download!

Firstly, thank you to the whole community for your patience. This content has been in development for a long while, bringing all the new elements together is never as easy as we would like. We're hoping the direction that this update takes us will keep pushing the game to be bigger and better, with the team now steering to a more content driven workflow.

What's in the update:
Moving away from the old static main menu to an area that you can walk around with a shooting range is a big improvement to the initial feel of the game, it allows users to get used to the game mechanics prior to entering games. A future release will have weapons scattered around for players to try.

We've now got the ability for users to create and upload custom maps to be played in private matches. Information on this can be found in ⁠mod-info
